title: Bumblebee dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='30' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#cfe9ff' transform='rotate(-25 38 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='28' rx='13' ry='8' fill='#e8f5ff' transform='rotate(20 62 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='36' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#a9d4f5' transform='rotate(-35 40 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='35' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#bde0f8' transform='rotate(30 63 35)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='20' ry='24' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <rect x='30' y='46' width='40' height='8' rx='4' fill='#4a3a8c'/>
  <rect x='31' y='62' width='38' height='8' rx='4' fill='#4a3a8c'/>
  <rect x='35' y='76' width='30' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#4a3a8c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='13' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <path d='M38 26 Q50 16 62 26' stroke='#4a3a8c' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a6b'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='31' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a6b'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 37 Q50 41 54 37' stroke='#3a2a6b' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M45 19 Q40 10 35 8' stroke='#4a3a8c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M55 19 Q60 10 65 8' stroke='#4a3a8c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='8' r='2.5' fill='#ff7ab0'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='8' r='2.5' fill='#ff7ab0'/>
  <!-- dancing arms/legs -->
  <path d='M30 52 Q20 46 16 38' stroke='#4a3a8c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 52 Q80 46 84 38' stroke='#4a3a8c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 78 Q28 88 26 94' stroke='#4a3a8c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 78 Q72 86 76 92' stroke='#4a3a8c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 80 L50 90' stroke='#4a3a8c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
